retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black background featuring a grayscale portrait and vertically elongated, overlapping primary-colored geometric lettering.
triggerTerms: high contrast grayscale portrait on black

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition on a solid black field where a low-angle grayscale portrait of a man occupies the bottom-left, looking upward toward a cluster of extremely tall, thin, overlapping letters in red, green, blue, and yellow.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait gaze directed toward the primary typographic focal point
Overlapping letterforms creating depth through color transparency effects
Contrast between organic photographic textures and sharp geometric lines
Asymmetrical balance between the heavy portrait and the airy, tall type
coreInvariants: Primary color palette for the main display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Grayscale portrait in the bottom-left quadrant, scaled to approximately one-third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, multi-colored overlapping word in the top-right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the portrait's face, follows the gaze upward to the colorful display text, then down to the secondary white text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the elements, emphasizing the high-contrast edges.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red, Green, Blue, Yellow (primary display text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primary colors against a zero-value black background.
paletteRestrictions: Vibrant primary red, green, blue, and yellow

letterConstructionRules: Overlapping strokes with simulated transparency or color blending
characterSpecificRedesigns: M and N characters share vertical stems to create a zigzag pattern
A has a high crossbar to maintain verticality
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between vertically distorted display lettering and stable, functional grotesque sans-serifs.

preserve: Vertical elongation of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, mid-century feel of the secondary text.
Necessary to achieve the extreme vertical distortion and overlapping of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast grayscale portrait of a man in 1950s attire, positioned in the bottom-left corner looking up and right, set against a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Create custom vector lettering for the main title using ultra-tall, thin strokes in red, green, blue, and yellow, overlapping them in the top right. Add secondary white grotesque sans-serif text in a horizontal block below the title.

verificationChecks: Are the tall letters overlapping with primary colors?
Is the portrait grayscale and high-contrast?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
Record label logos or catalog numbers
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the tall letters do not touch the portrait.
Ensure the white text is legible against the black.
Verify the primary colors are vibrant and not muddy.
Confirm the portrait gaze aligns with the display text.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast grayscale portrait + solid black field + vertically stretched primary-colored overlapping geometric type.
